subject: BrightHarbor MAP: onboarding cadence & close criteria
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Evans <jordan.evans@brightharborhealth.com>, Naveen Kumar <naveen.kumar@brightharborhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-10T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: BrightHarbor MAP: onboarding cadence & close criteria

Jordan / Naveen —

Great to meet you both last week. Per our call, I wanted to put a concise mutual action plan (MAP) on your radar so we can align on cadence, owners, and success criteria for a 6-week evaluation and decision timeline. I’ve attached a first-pass MAP spreadsheet and a short security summary for your procurement team.

High level proposal (skim-friendly):
- Cadence: weekly 30-minute MAP checkpoints (Tuesdays 10:00am PT) for 6 weeks
- Core stakeholders: Jordan (Clinical Ops), Naveen (IT/Security), Marissa (Solutions — Redwood), Ben (Sales Eng — Redwood), me (AM)
- Success criteria to validate before close:
  - Latency and throughput: < 200ms p50 on our staging dataset at your peak patterns
  - Data controls: VPC + encryption, audit logs accessible by BH security
  - Cost estimate: within the budget envelope you provided ($X–$Y / month)
  - Integration: end-to-end inference in your staging environment with test dataset

Immediate asks from our side:
1) Confirm a recurring meeting slot — proposed Tuesdays 10:00am PT (please confirm or suggest)
2) Confirm owners for the three acceptance criteria above (latency, security, integration)
3) Share any vendor questionnaire or mandatory evidence items we should prioritize (SOC2 cert, encryption details, data flow diagrams)

Attachments: BrightHarbor_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP with week-by-week owners & checkpoints), Redwood_Security_Summary.pdf

If that looks reasonable I’ll have Marissa drop a more detailed week-by-week acceptance table before our first checkpoint. Thanks — looking forward to a smooth evaluation.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Thanks for the clear plan and the attachments. Tuesdays at 10:00am PT should work for the team — I’ll tentatively accept and send a calendar invite once Naveen confirms. Quick notes from my side:

- Security: Naveen will own SOC2/technical evidence but he asked whether you can share a short appendix that maps your controls to our questionnaire (the PDF is a good start).

Subject: BrightHarbor MAP: week-by-week acceptance plan + owners (v1)

Hi Jordan / Naveen —

Following Soojin’s note, I’ve converted the MAP into a week-by-week acceptance table (high level) below — this is also in the attached BrightHarbor_MAP_v1.xlsx for your tracker. I put owners on the right and marked must-have vs nice-to-have. Please flag any changes.

Week 0 (kickoff) — Align stakeholders, share PoC endpoints
- Owner: Soojin / Jordan
- Acceptance: calendar and access provisioned

Week 1 — Integration smoke test (staging)
- Owner: Ben / Naveen
- Acceptance: sample workload runs end-to-end; basic metrics captured (latency p50/p95)

Week 2 — Security evidence delivery and review
- Owner: Redwood Security (Rachel) / Naveen
- Acceptance: SOC2 summary + controls mapping; VPC/network diagram; NDA executed

Week 3 — Performance ramp & cost estimate
- Owner: Ben / Soojin
- Acceptance: run at 50% expected peak and confirm cost model, notes on caching/batching options

Week 4 — Business stakeholder review (exec summary)
- Owner: Jordan / Soojin
- Acceptance: decision packet for procurement (pricing + security + perf)

Week 5 — Final QA and rollback/fallback plan
- Owner: Ben / Marissa
- Acceptance: runbook and SLA expectations documented

Week 6 — Close / rollout plan or pause decision
- Owner: Jordan / Soojin
- Acceptance: signed SOW or next steps agreed

Quick answers to earlier asks:
- We can provide a staging endpoint + small workload script by end of day Wednesday — Ben is on this.
- Rachel Kim from our security team will join the Week 2 call (adding her here).

Attachments: BrightHarbor_MAP_v1.xlsx (detailed table), Signed_NDA_BH.pdf (NDA template — please countersign if good).

If this schedule maps to your internal approvals timeline, we’ll lock the recurring meeting and start week 0 next Tuesday.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
